ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-contrast bimodal distribution; approximately 80% low-intensity (black) pixels concentrated in the central and proximal regions, with 20% high-intensity (white) pixels localized at the distal fluke tips.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant low-intensity central mass spanning both lobes; high-intensity white patches are mapped to the distal ends of the lobes, specifically a large contiguous white region on the right lobe tip containing fragmented dark pixel clusters.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency jagged serrations along the trailing edge; right lobe exhibits larger amplitude pixel-valleys and peaks compared to the more uniform left lobe edge.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Trailing edges exhibit a concave sweep from the median notch toward the distal tips; leading edges (partially submerged) show convex curvature.

localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Fine, vertical low-intensity linear marks visible across the dark pigmented surface of the left lobe.

other_distinctive_markers: Unique stippled pigmentation pattern at the transition zone between black and white fields on the right lobe's distal surface.
